flow: inputs change -> live service re-evaluates -> watchdog -> desk board and status endpoint (always on, not scheduled)

services.name: frac_live
services.note: NOT scheduled: stays running, re-evaluates the moment the input files change, backs off on failure, stops and raises an alert after repeated failures. Read-only status on localhost only. Never downloads data (FracFocus terms need a person) and never touches the globe or UI. If Hermes cannot supervise a service, use integration/god-mode/com.amara.frac-live.plist.

desk.note: read-only live terminal board: status, risk, per-county edge for water and sand, event tape. Exit code with --once: 0 OK, 1 WARN, 2 ALERT, 3 feed down.

failure_policy: tests fail -> no backtest runs; a failed run backs off and retries; repeated failures stop the service and write ALERT.md; a failed publish never deletes local results; outputs are ESTIMATE-labeled backtests, not live forecasts
